scope: 95 printable ASCII plus every current menu CJK/punctuation character and math multiply/minus; LEVEL material variants have only LEVEL123.
limitation: Original SDF expanded 3x then rasterized for 50px UI use. Dynamic Unity SDF material remains a sampling approximation, and no kerning pairs are copied. Unsupported locales use runtime native font fallback.
